title: Ankita Bhandari’s Parents Stage Dharna At Rajghat, Removed By Police

ai.summary: Parents of Ankita Bhandari, murdered at a Uttarakhand resort in 2022, staged a dharna at Rajghat but were removed by police after refusing to disperse. The incident occurred two weeks after their detention protesting Sikkim governor appointments.

facts.claim: Bhandari's parents staged a dharna at Rajghat
facts.quote: Parents of Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered at a resort in Uttarakhand in 2022, were removed from Rajghat after they staged a dharna near the public gate of Mahatma Gandhi's memorial, sources said.

facts.claim: The dharna was not at a designated protest site
facts.quote: They later staged a dharna along with two others near the public gate, which is not a designated protest site, a police source said.

facts.claim: Parents were removed after refusing to disperse
facts.quote: The group was repeatedly asked to disperse. After they refused to budge, they were removed from the spot.
Bhandari, who worked as a receptionist at the Vanantra Resort in Rishikesh, was killed on September 18, 2022.

facts.claim: Parents were detained two weeks prior
facts.quote: This comes a fortnight after Bhandari's parents were detained by police while protesting against the appointment of Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim governor near India Gate on October 14.

ai.background_note: Parents of Ankita Bhandari, murdered in 2022, staged a dharna at Rajghat but were removed by police after refusing to disperse. This follows their prior detention protesting Sikkim governor appointments.
